output.title: Ingress/Gateway annotation copying feature scope unclear
output.content: This adds the --extra-certificate-annotations option to copy annotations from Ingress or Gateway resources to Certificate objects. The environment does not explicitly state whether cert-manager ingress-shim or Gateway support is enabled. If Ingress-based certificate management is used, this feature enables flexible annotation propagation. Check your cert-manager configuration for ingress-shim or Gateway integration.
